## P21.6 — Curation web UI (authenticated review-queue + L0 entry as a web surface)

Stacked on `devin/p21-5-infra-deposit-and-tiles`. Builds the curation surface Phase 5 deferred (LD-F05/LD-H04): reviewers work the ER review queue and contradiction/task dispositions in a browser, L0 contributors submit through the web, every action lands as an **append-only row with a human actor id**, and machine suggestions are **labelled, never auto-applied**.

### Decision gate — RUN AS WRITTEN
A6 was ticked (CLI+JSONL accepted as the Phase-5 conforming form) **and** the operator wants the web surface as the Phase-21 enhancement → not skipped. **P21.2 shipped the shrunk case** (compute-on-read; no new annotation-persistence repos), so curation writes use the **existing** paths: the append-only **JSONL curation log** and P19.5's **`PgReviewQueue`/`review_decision`** for ER decisions, and **compute-on-read** for contradiction/task dispositions (stated in ADR-068 + CURATION_UI.md). Every write is still append-only with a human actor id.

### What shipped
- **Curation API** (`api/src/api/curation.py`, `create_curation_app`/`sig-api serve-curation`): disabled-by-default (routes structurally **absent** without `SIG_CURATION_ENABLED=1`, RISK-P21-10), never on the public API process (Part VIII §0.7); bearer-token auth bound to the P16.1 **pseudonymous** contributor tiers with per-route tier checks (401/403); every write one append-only row with a human actor id; anti-poisoning server-side; suggestions labelled + never auto-applied (**amends ADR-030**).
- **Runtime**: `ops/docker-compose.yml` `api-curation` service (loopback, `curation` profile); `sig-ops up/status/down` manage + report it **separately** (authenticated, non-public).
- **Web** (`web/src/pages/curate/**`, `CurateLayout`, `lib/curation.ts`): progressively-enhanced **no-JS** forms (queue → side-by-side compare+decide → dispositions → L0 submit → revert) under **WCAG 2.2 AA** but not the public zero-JS budget; `lighthouserc.json` `/curate/**` block; public pages keep script size 0.
- **Docs**: ADR-068 (+ README + Appendix F, spec rebuilt), RISK-P21-10/11, `docs/build/CURATION_UI.md` (run/roles/walkthrough), COVERAGE_MATRIX (SIG-PUB-012), traceability; BACKLOG **BL-009 closed** (asset-promotion service → P21.7).

### Acceptance / evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| routes absent 404 without flag; 401 unauth; 403 tier-insufficient; decide writes exactly one row; repeat appends another (never mutates) | `tests/api/test_curation.py` (21 tests) |
| no decision writable without a human actor id — enumerates every write path | `test_curation_log_refuses_empty_actor`, `test_every_write_route_requires_auth_so_carries_an_actor`, `test_all_router_post_paths_are_covered_by_the_enumeration` |
| `curate.spec.ts` + `.nojs` green; axe WCAG 2.2 AA on every `/curate/` page; public pages script size 0 | `web/tests/e2e/curate.spec.ts`, `curate.nojs.spec.ts`, `a11y.spec.ts`; `lighthouserc.json` |
| `api-curation` bound to a non-public interface; `sig-ops status` shows it separately | `tests/ops/test_curation_service.py`; live: real `serve-curation` binds `127.0.0.1` only |
| reviewer processes an ER item list→compare→decide without JS | walkthrough in `docs/build/CURATION_UI.md` + `curate.nojs.spec.ts` |
| phase gate | `make check` green (**2585 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed, 0 xfailed**); web `npm run check` green (188 e2e); verify-gen clean; ADR-068 + risk + traceability + BACKLOG |

### Out of scope (honored)
MapRoulette/OSM contribution-back + usability study (P21.7); new ER logic; new persistence (P21.2 shrunk → JSONL/PgReviewQueue used); account provisioning beyond P16.1 tier tokens; asset-promotion service (still unwired; SIG-PUB-012 stays PARTIAL).

Requirement ids: SIG-CONTRIB-*, SIG-LLM-001..007, SIG-UI-036..041, SIG-IDENT-025/026.
